summary: Customer wants to assess whether a fiber-based measurement in the feed frame can follow API concentration changes in a powder blend during tablet manufacture, and asks that a first pilot compare reasonable measurement options before committing to production equipment.

facts_stated.text: The tablets are made from a powder blend.
The blend contains an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients

facts_stated.text: Laboratory checks indicate whether the blend is on target.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Laboratory checks tell us whether the blend is on target

facts_stated.text: Laboratory results arrive after the material has moved through the press.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: results arrive after the material has moved through the press

facts_stated.text: They want to assess a fiber-based measurement in the feed frame.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: fiber based measurement in the feed frame

facts_stated.text: The measurement is intended to follow API concentration changes.
A first pilot should compare reasonable measurement options.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: first pilot should compare reasonable measurement options

facts_stated.text: The production equipment commitment comes after the pilot.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: before we commit to production equipment
